rows.reasoning: Rogers co-sponsored SB 1265 and voted Yes on it and on HB 2552, single-subject bills whose operative section 16-605 bars the state and its subdivisions from tabulating ballots through multiple rounds of elimination and vote transfer. That is a legal ban on ranked-choice voting, matching the rung "Ban ranked-choice voting by law."
